verdict.rationale: Supermemory's docs describe container tags as data-isolation boundaries (multi-tenancy) and API key existence (minted outside app.supermemory.ai), but there is no evidence of issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials (e.g., read-only, tag-restricted, or role-limited keys) for agents. In fact, community evidence about the official MCP server indicates the opposite pattern — no auth at all, with a URL/nanoid serving as the sole 'key' — undermining any implicit claim of credential scoping.
